findings.title: unsubscribe action crashes for anonymous users and missing TopicUser rows
findings.body: `unsubscribe` calls `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, ...)` but the route is skipped for login only via before_filter ensure_logged_in (which is listed), so this is OK for logged-in users; however `tu` can be nil when the user has no TopicUser record for the topic (e.g. they were never tracked or the record was never created), and `tu.notification_level` then raises NoMethodError (500). Should use TopicUser.change or handle nil.

findings.title: unsubscribe toggle bypasses TopicUser.change and its side effects
findings.body: The notification level is set by assigning and calling tu.save! directly, instead of TopicUser.change. This skips the MessageBus notification_level_change publish, notifications_changed_at/notifications_reason_id updates, and observer callbacks, so open clients don't update and the reason is not recorded.

findings.title: unsubscribe is a GET with state change and no CSRF protection against link-based toggling
findings.body: The unsubscribe route is GET and mutates notification level, so any link or image embedding the URL can change a user's notification state (and the toggle semantics mean repeated/prefetched requests flip it back and forth). Email link prefetchers can silently toggle the setting. Mutation should happen on POST with confirmation.

findings.title: TopicView.new with no guardian check on topic visibility before mutating
findings.body: unsubscribe builds TopicView for params[:topic_id] using current_user, but it does not verify the user can see the topic before writing a TopicUser row; for private topics the user may still get a TopicUser row created or modified. Also TopicView.new raises NotFound only on missing topic; a missing TopicUser then crashes as noted.

findings.title: Added render :show in format.html block is redundant/inconsistent and changes show behavior
findings.body: Adding an explicit `render :show` inside format.html in perform_show_response is unnecessary for show, and because unsubscribe now also calls perform_show_response, unsubscribe renders the topic show template with the store_preloaded data; this couples the unsubscribe response to the full topic page and the topic route template, which the new unsubscribe Ember route does not expect.

findings.title: unsubscribe_url built from url with post_number absent produces a URL that depends on slug
findings.body: unsubscribe_url uses `url` which includes the slug; the email link is generated at send time and the route `t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe` redirects to the correct slug when mismatched, but the non-slug route `t/:topic_id/unsubscribe` exists too, so the generated link is fine; however the method is added without any spec, and it is called in user_notifications for every notification email, adding no guard for nil slug (slug falls back to ''), producing `/t//id/unsubscribe`.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link now always includes topic link even when no unsubscribe_url is passed
findings.body: The unsubscribe_link text now references %{unsubscribe_url}, but MessageBuilder#body and html_part call I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args) for every email with add_unsubscribe_link, and digest and other emails that do not pass unsubscribe_url will render the placeholder literally or raise I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument, since the key is not provided. Only notification emails pass unsubscribe_url.

findings.title: Template no longer includes the topic unsubscribe link placeholder in the html part
findings.body: The html notification template uses %{unsubscribe_link} as a placeholder, which is replaced only in MessageBuilder#html_part; that is fine, but the new unsubscribe_link text is rendered as PrettyText markdown inside a div, and the %{unsubscribe_url} placeholder is only interpolated in the text body via I18n, so the HTML version shows an unexpanded or stale topic link. Verify both parts receive the topic-specific URL.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link interpolation may fail for emails without unsubscribe_url
findings.body: html_part and body call I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args) whenever add_unsubscribe_link is set. The new locale string requires %{unsubscribe_url}; any caller setting add_unsubscribe_link without unsubscribe_url (e.g. mailing list or other mailers) will raise a missing interpolation error or emit a broken link. Builder should default unsubscribe_url or guard it.

findings.title: Misspelled property name stopNotificiationsText
findings.body: The property name is misspelled ('Notificiations'), and the template references the same misspelling; it works but is a maintenance hazard and inconsistent with other names.

findings.title: Route creates a topic record with store.createRecord on every visit
findings.body: model() calls this.store.createRecord('topic', { id }) each time the route is entered, leaving unsaved phantom topic records in the store and the topic is then populated via updateFromJson; repeated visits accumulate records and may collide with the real topic model.

findings.title: didTransition action returns true and sets application footer as side effect
findings.body: The didTransition action is defined under actions but is not triggered by any Ember hook here; it is dead code, and the footer state is never restored when leaving the route.

findings.title: No spec covers the new topic-specific unsubscribe link text or the missing-url path
findings.body: The spec adds unsubscribe_url to the builder, but never checks that the body/html includes the topic unsubscribe URL, nor that builds without unsubscribe_url succeed (which the new locale string would break). No controller spec covers the new unsubscribe action either.
